dedupe_keys.name: istanbul transport demand forecasting model data ulasım talep tahmin modeli verisi 2020 base year and 2040 projection

description: This dataset publishes the inputs and results of the Istanbul Transport Model, the strategic four-step demand model that grew out of the Istanbul Transportation Master Plan launched by the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality in 2012. It holds the modelled road network for 2020 and 2040, the public transport network and lines for both years, assignment tables and origin-destination matrices, a comparison of observed and modelled flows, and a field description. The model was calibrated and validated for 2020 and, according to the Department of Transportation, matches real boardings by more than 95% line by line on rail and at macro scale for other modes; the 2040 run uses the 18.6 million population projection of the Turkish Statistical Institute. Assignment is hourly for the morning peak (07:00 to 08:00, December 2019 data), with a public transport value of time of 0.35, two iterations, and distance-based fares on Marmaray, Metrobüs and Hızray. Coverage is the Istanbul metropolitan area. The 16 files (XLSX tables and KMZ network layers) are free to download from the İBB open data portal under the İBB Open Data Licence, which allows commercial reuse with attribution. Caveats: only the morning peak hour is modelled, the files are model outputs, not counts, the documentation is in Turkish, and the unit of the value of time is not stated. The data support network flow and capacity planning studies of roads and public transport, and pair with the hourly İstanbulkart ridership catalogued here for validation.
